# Controls

<!-- Generated by `coney-tools refs render` from research/references/controls.yaml. Do not edit. -->

The pad as the game reads it: the 16-bit button word, the analog sticks, and the markup tag that
draws each button in text. Coney drives everything as a gamepad with analog sticks; on a PC pad the face
buttons are positional (south is cross).

!!! info "What is complete"

    Every button bit and both sticks are listed. What each does on foot is still to be written;
    the front end's accept and back are known ([Front end](../research/frontend.md#input)).

18 entries. Data: `research/references/controls.yaml`.
